meta.name: eval-run
meta.description: Evaluate any output file against a structured evals.yaml assertions file and produce a score report with per-assertion pass/fail results. Activate when the Discovery Agent runs the Skill Optimize protocol to measure output quality or detect regressions after skill instruction changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据断言规则评估文件质量并输出评分报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在修改指令后自动检测输出是否达标
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate file quality against assertion rules and produce a score report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically check output quality after instruction changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的 evals.yaml 断言文件，对任意输出文件执行代码检查或 LLM 评判，并生成每项断言通过/失败的结构化评分报告。
howto.when: 当你提供输出文件路径和 evals.yaml 断言文件时触发。常用于量化评估技能输出质量或检测修改后的性能变化。

say.text: 请用 evals.yaml 评估 output.txt 的质量。
say.note: 它会运行所有断言，返回通过/失败结果。

say.text: 帮我检查这篇稿子字数是否在合理范围。
say.note: 需在 evals.yaml 中定义字数断言。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can evaluate any output file against a structured evals.yaml assertions file, running code checks or LLM judgments, and produce a score report with per-assertion pass/fail results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an output file path and an evals.yaml assertions file. Typically used to quantify skill output quality or detect regressions after modifications.

say_en.note: Runs all assertions, returns pass/fail results.

say_en.text: Check if this draft's word count is within range.
